dataQuality.missingPrice: {count} asset(s) have no market price — excluded from NAV
dataQuality.transactionImplied: {count} asset(s) valued at their last transaction price — no market price available for over 2 weeks (as of {as_of_date})
dataQuality.currentPriceAssumedAtCost: Current price unavailable — open value estimated at cost, market P&L excluded
dataQuality.currentPriceAssumedAtCostRange: No market price available between {date_from} and {date_to} — open value estimated at cost, market P&L excluded
dataQuality.missingFx: Missing FX rates for {count} pair(s) — totals may be incomplete
dataQuality.navIncomplete: NAV incomplete for {count} day(s) between {date_from} and {date_to}
dataQuality.mwrrNotAvailable: MWRR cannot be calculated for this period
dataQuality.archivedAsset: This asset is archived — not updated by scheduler
dataQuality.fxPairMissing: FX pair not configured — conversion not available
dataQuality.fxPairPartialGap: Partial gap in rates — data from {date}
dataQuality.referencePriceFallback: Lots opened by an adjustment on a day without a market quote: their Open Return starts from the last price on or before that day, an earlier quote or the price of a purchase or sale
dataQuality.referencePriceUnavailable: Lots opened by an adjustment before any price: their Open Return starts from their own purchase cost per unit, and is not available without one
dataQuality.shortTransferNotSupported: Transferring a short position is not supported yet
dataQuality.shortAdjustmentNotSupported: An adjustment cannot open or close a short position yet
dataQuality.fifoSourceQuantityMissing: Removes {missing_quantity} more than the broker held that day
dataQuality.transferPairMissing: A transfer is missing its paired transaction, or the pair is invalid
dataQuality.missingFxRates: FX rates missing for {count} pair(s) between {date_from} and {date_to} ({dates_count} date(s)) — sync to complete totals
dataQuality.missingFxRatesManual: FX rates missing for {count} manual pair(s) — add rates manually
dataQuality.assetIncomeNoEligibleLots: No open lot eligible for {economic_type} of {target_amount} {target_currency} on {as_of_date} — income left unallocated
dataQuality.assetCostNoEligibleLots: No lot eligible for {economic_type} of {target_amount} {target_currency} on {as_of_date} — cost left unallocated
dataQuality.missingFxRatesAfterSync: FX rates are still missing for {pairs} between {date_from} and {date_to} ({dates_count} date(s)): the provider returned none for those dates. Enter them by hand on the pair’s page.
dataQuality.missingCostBasis: {count} asset(s) have an acquisition without a purchase cost — counted at zero until you set it
dataQuality.valuedAtCost: {count} asset(s) valued at cost — no price available for over 2 weeks (as of {as_of_date})
dataQuality.transferShareMismatch: {count} transfer(s) between brokers where your share differs — the difference counts as a gain or loss
dataQuality.invalidSplitRatio: {count} asset(s) have a split with an invalid ratio — ignored until you fix it in the asset's events
dataQuality.transactionsBeforeFloor: {count} transaction(s) dated before 1900 (the earliest on {earliest}) — the history starts on 1 January 1900: correct their dates
dataQuality.quoteInMinorUnit: {count} asset(s) quoted in pence (GBp) by their provider and valued as pounds — set “Units per single price” to 100 on each
